verdict.rationale: Chronicle publishes its own API reference section covering authentication, reliability, telemetry and per-language SDKs, including method-to-endpoint mappings such as events.search → POST /v1/search. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or that examples can be run, and probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it/playground in the API reference, runnable code examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
